card.name: Punctuation in drug-interaction lists
card.fires_on: The colon after the class name Antiarrhythmics, and commas inside lists of interacting drug names, in drug-interaction tables. It is strongest on the colon right after Antiarrhythmics.

modes.label: Colon after Antiarrhythmics
modes.description: A colon right after the drug class heading Antiarrhythmics, before a list of named drugs.

modes.label: Comma in drug lists
modes.description: A comma between drug names in lists of QT-prolonging or contraindicated drugs.
